name: Ootori Hazuki
source:
Often called "Ha-chan".
That poor girl is at the mercy of Chairman because of her timidity.
She has an older brother that is quite popular at school.
She is in Yuuta's group.
Not good with carrots.

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
